name: Faber-Castell Classic Colour Pencils 24
description: Faber-Castell's classic hexagonal colour pencils in a sturdy tin of 24. Break-resistant SV-bonded leads lay down smooth, blendable colour for school projects and sketchbooks, and the FSC-certified cedar sharpens cleanly without splintering.

name: Faber-Castell Castell 9000 Graphite Set 6
description: The legendary Castell 9000 graphite pencils in six drawing grades from 2B to 8B. Top-quality graphite gives deep blacks for sketching and precise greys for technical drawing, diagrams and shading practice.

name: Faber-Castell Connector Pens 24
description: Washable Connector felt-tip pens in 24 bright colours with caps that clip together for building. Medium tips suit colouring, charts and classroom posters, and the ink washes out of most fabrics.

name: Faber-Castell Grip Ball Pen 3-Pack
description: Ergonomic triangular Grip ball pens, three per pack, shaped to hold the fingers correctly through long exam hours. Smooth 1.0 mm black-blue line with smudge-resistant, quick-drying ink.

name: Camlin Scholar Geometry Box
description: Camlin Scholar geometry box with compass, divider, set squares, protractor, scale, pencil, eraser and sharpener in a crush-resistant metal case. Everything the SEE maths syllabus needs in one box.

name: Camlin Watercolour Cakes 24 Shades
description: Twenty-four vivid watercolour cakes with a brush tucked in the lid. Colours dissolve evenly with water for washes and posters, and the palette box doubles as a mixing tray.

name: Camlin Mechanical Pencil 0.7
description: Comfort-grip 0.7 mm mechanical pencil with a steady line for writing and diagrams. Ships with spare leads and a twist eraser, so it is ready for class out of the pack.

name: Camlin Whiteboard Markers 4-Set
description: Four low-odour bullet-tip whiteboard markers in black, blue, red and green. Dense ink wipes clean off whiteboards and glass without ghosting.

name: Casio fx-991ES Plus Scientific Calculator
description: The fx-991ES Plus scientific calculator with 417 functions and a natural textbook display that shows fractions and roots as written. Solar-assisted power with battery backup, approved for SEE and +2 board exams.

name: Casio MJ-12D Desktop Calculator
description: Full-size desktop calculator with a big tilted 12-digit display that reads clearly across a shop counter. Tax, discount and currency keys plus a sturdy build for daily billing.

name: Deli 0.5 mm Gel Pens 6-Pack
description: Six quick-dry 0.5 mm black gel pens that glide without smudging — enough for a whole term of notes. Comfortable barrel and steady ink flow from first page to last.

name: Deli A4 Spiral Notebook 200 Pages
description: A4 spiral notebook with 200 thick 80 gsm ruled pages that take gel ink without bleeding through. Sturdy covers and a lay-flat spiral survive a year in a school bag.

name: Deli No.12 Metal Stapler Set
description: All-metal No.12 stapler with a box of pins and a remover for home-office paperwork. Pins up to 20 sheets cleanly with a soft, low-effort press.

name: Deli Correction Tape 2-Pack
description: Twin pack of one-line correction tape with instant, no-dry coverage over ballpoint and gel ink. Precise applicator tip reaches single characters.

name: Deli 175 mm Craft Scissors
description: 175 mm stainless craft scissors with soft-grip handles for paper, photos and classroom craft. Sharp, rust-resistant blades stay aligned use after use.

name: Anker Soundcore R50i True Wireless Earbuds
description: Anker Soundcore R50i true-wireless earbuds with custom 10 mm drivers for deep BassUp sound. Bluetooth 5.3, AI clear calls, IPX5 sweat resistance and 30 hours of total playtime with the pocketable case.

name: Anker 511 Nano 30W USB-C Charger
description: Anker 511 Nano 30W pocket charger that fast-charges phones, buds and tablets from a single USB-C port. GaN circuitry keeps it half the size of stock bricks while running cool and safe.

name: Anker PowerCore 10000 PD
description: Slim 10000 mAh Anker bank with high-speed USB-C output for phones on the move — roughly two full charges for most handsets. Airline-safe capacity with surge and short-circuit protection.

name: Mi Power Bank 3i 20000 mAh
description: Xiaomi Power Bank 3i with a huge 20000 mAh cell, 18W fast charging and dual USB output for two devices at once. Twelve-layer circuit protection and a low-power mode for bands and buds.

name: Mi Smart Band 8
description: Mi Smart Band 8 with a bright 1.62-inch AMOLED display, 150+ sport modes and a 16-day typical battery. Tracks heart rate, SpO2, sleep and stress, and survives swims at 5 ATM.

name: Logitech M331 Silent Plus Mouse
description: Logitech M331 Silent Plus wireless mouse with 90%-quieter clicks, 1000 DPI precision and a 24-month battery from one AA cell. Plug-and-forget nano receiver works up to 10 metres.

name: Logitech G102 Lightsync Gaming Mouse
description: Logitech G102 Lightsync gaming mouse with an 8000 DPI gaming-grade sensor, customisable RGB and six programmable buttons. Nepal's favourite budget esports mouse — accurate, light and built to click for millions of presses.

name: Logitech K120 Wired Keyboard
description: Full-size Logitech K120 wired keyboard with deep, quiet keys and a spill-resistant design that shrugs off tea accidents. Plug-and-play USB with zero setup on any computer.

name: JBL Go 3 Portable Speaker
description: Pocket-size JBL Go 3 with 4.2W of surprisingly big JBL Pro Sound, IP67 waterproofing and 5 hours of playtime. Bluetooth 5.1, fabric finish and a carry loop — built for bags, bikes and monsoon.

name: JBL Tune 510BT Headphones
description: Foldable JBL Tune 510BT on-ears with 40 hours of battery, JBL Pure Bass and hands-free calls. Flat-folds into a backpack and quick-charges hours of playback in minutes.

name: boAt Airdopes 141 TWS
description: boAt Airdopes 141 true-wireless buds with 8 mm drivers, 42 hours of total backup and ENx clear-call mics. ASAP fast charging and instant pairing make them a daily-driver favourite.

name: Ugreen 100W USB-C Cable 2 m
description: Braided 2-metre Ugreen USB-C cable rated for 100W Power Delivery — fast-charges laptops, phones and power banks alike. Nylon jacket and reinforced necks survive bag abuse.

name: Ugreen Nexode 65W GaN Charger
description: Ugreen Nexode 65W GaN charger with two USB-C ports plus USB-A — enough for a laptop and two phones from one wall socket. Gallium-nitride tech keeps it small and cool under load.

name: Baseus Bipow 20000 mAh 20W
description: Baseus Bipow 20000 mAh bank with 20W USB-C fast output and an LED percentage display, so the remaining charge is always visible. Triple output shares power across three devices.

name: Samsung 25W Travel Adapter
description: Official Samsung 25W Super-Fast travel adapter with a USB-C cable in the box. Charges Galaxy phones at full Super-Fast speed and safely tops up any USB-C device.

name: Casio F-91W Digital Watch
description: The indestructible Casio F-91W digital: alarm, stopwatch, calendar and a ~7-year battery in a feather-light resin case. An icon that outlives trends — and most other watches.

name: Casio A158WA Vintage Silver
description: Retro Casio A158WA with a polished stainless case and band, daily alarm and stopwatch. Slim on the wrist and sharp with everything from kurtas to blazers.

name: Casio MTP-V002 Leather Analog
description: Slim Casio MTP-V002 analog with a clean dial, date window and genuine leather strap. Quietly formal — the office and wedding watch that never tries too hard.

name: Titan Analog Leather 1823SL01
description: Titan 1823SL01 with a deep-blue dial, date display and genuine leather strap. Quartz accuracy with Titan's finish and service backing, boxed for gifting.

name: Fastrack Analog Black Leather
description: Bold black-dial Fastrack analog on a leather strap — young, loud and built for daily wear. Quartz movement with splash resistance for everyday life.

name: Fastrack Reflex Vybe Band
description: Slim Fastrack Reflex Vybe fitness band tracking 10 sport modes plus heart rate, SpO2 and sleep, with a week-plus battery. Light on the wrist, loud on looks.

name: Wildcraft 45L Travel Rucksack
description: Wildcraft 45L travel rucksack with rain cover, padded laptop sleeve and load-balancing hip belt. Built for Annapurna circuits and semester-abroad moves alike.

name: American Tourister Cabin Case 55 cm
description: American Tourister 55 cm hard-shell cabin case with smooth spinner wheels and a TSA lock. Scratch-tough shell sized for airline overhead bins.

name: Puma Baseball Cap
description: Classic Puma baseball cap in breathable cotton twill with an embroidered cat logo. Adjustable strap fits most heads; shields sun on rides and matches.

name: Adidas Adilette Comfort Slides
description: Adidas Adilette Comfort slides with a Cloudfoam footbed that cushions every step. Single-bandage synthetic upper dries fast — home, hostel and post-match feet sorted.

name: Nike Everyday Socks 3-Pack
description: Three pairs of Nike Everyday cushioned crew socks with arch support and Dri-FIT sweat control. Reinforced heels and toes survive daily wear and wash cycles.

name: Puma Everyday Backpack 21L
description: Puma everyday backpack with a padded 15-inch laptop sleeve, bottle pockets and cushioned straps for college commutes. Zips and fabric built for daily overloading.

name: Titan Aviator Sunglasses
description: Titan metal aviators with full UV protection and spring hinges that flex instead of snapping. Timeless pilot shape that suits most Nepali face shapes.

name: Fastrack Wayfarer Sunglasses
description: Retro Fastrack wayfarers in acetate with shatter-resistant UV lenses. Light, bold and hard to lose — the everyday sunglasses that go with everything.

name: Puma Smash Leather Sneakers
description: Puma Smash leather sneakers with a clean court profile, cushioned tongue and grippy rubber cupsole. Full-grain leather that ages well with daily rotation.

name: Rubik's 3x3 Speed Cube
description: The original Rubik's 3x3 speed cube with smoother, faster turning and durable stickerless tiles. Official 56 mm tournament size — the puzzle every desk deserves.

name: LEGO Classic Creative Box
description: LEGO Classic medium box with 484 bricks in 35 colours plus windows, doors and baseplate ideas for open-ended building. The perfect first big LEGO set for ages 4 and up.

name: UNO Card Game
description: 112 cards of reverses, skips, wilds and dreaded +4s — the family game-night fix that fits in a pocket. For 2 to 10 players; grudges guaranteed.

name: Monopoly Classic Board Game
description: Monopoly Classic: buy streets, build houses, bankrupt the family the traditional way. Eight tokens, full board and paper money for 2 to 8 players, ages 8+.

name: Fujifilm Instax Mini Film Twin Pack
description: Twin pack of Fujifilm Instax Mini film — 20 credit-card-size instant prints for any Instax Mini camera. Weddings, trips and room walls start here.

name: Govee RGB LED Strip 5 m
description: Five metres of app-controlled Govee RGB strip light with a built-in mic that pulses to music. Timers, dimming and millions of colours for room glow-ups and Dashain decor.

name: Milton Thermosteel Flask 1L
description: Milton Thermosteel 1-litre flask in food-grade stainless that keeps chai hot (or water icy) for 24 hours. Leakproof, sweat-free exterior for bags and bike holders.

name: Milton Insulated Lunch Set
description: Three stainless Milton containers in one insulated carrier — the office tiffin that keeps lunch warm till 1 pm. Leakproof lids survive crowded micro rides.

name: Boldfit Yoga Mat 6 mm
description: Boldfit 6 mm anti-skid yoga mat with dual-texture grip and a carry strap. Thick enough for knees on concrete floors, grippy enough for power flows.

name: Boldfit Skipping Rope
description: Adjustable Boldfit skipping rope with smooth ball bearings and foam grips for cardio anywhere — terrace, park or hostel corridor. Trims to your height in seconds.

name: Boldfit Resistance Bands 5-Set
description: Five stackable Boldfit latex bands from 10 to 50 lb for full-body training without a gym. Includes handles and door anchor for presses, rows and curls.

name: Cello H2O Bottles 1L 2-Pack
description: Two leakproof 1-litre Cello H2O bottles for fridge, desk and gym bag. Food-grade plastic with flip caps you can open one-handed mid-ride.

name: Quechua NH100 20L Daypack
description: Quechua NH100 20-litre daypack with padded back, straps and bottle holders — sized for Shivapuri day hikes and daily college carry alike.

name: Naturehike LED Camping Lantern
description: Rechargeable Naturehike warm-light lantern with three brightness modes for load-shedding nights and campsites. USB-C charging plus a hook for tents and wires.

name: Philips 9W LED Bulbs 4-Pack
description: Four Philips 9W daylight LED bulbs that brighten whole rooms while sipping power and staying cool. Standard bayonet fitting, instant full brightness.
